content.title: Empty-City Infected Turn | Quiet Search to Crowd Threat Reveal
content.summary: An adult surveyor is pursued from an empty dock into a locked container passage. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: An empty baseline and one repeated backward check establish the unresolved threat question. + The first distant figure appears on the already established background axis. + Threat quantity or proximity escalates before the protagonist begins running. + The escape route preserves pursuers in the same background geography. + The terminal obstacle converts pursuit into a measurable unresolved distance without false resolution.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one adult surveyor in a yellow jacket on an empty foggy dock, repeatedly checking the silent water behind her. Add two more figures beside stacked crates while the surveyor turns and confirms all three. At a locked mesh gate, show the remaining distance collapse without cutting away or inventing a rescue.

The first distant figure appears on the already established background axis.

invariants.rule: An empty baseline and one repeated backward check establish the unresolved threat question.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "An empty baseline and one repeated backward check establish the unresolved threat question."

invariants.rule: The first distant figure appears on the already established background axis.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The first distant figure appears on the already established background axis."

invariants.rule: Threat quantity or proximity escalates before the protagonist begins running.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Threat quantity or proximity escalates before the protagonist begins running."

invariants.rule: The escape route preserves pursuers in the same background geography.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The escape route preserves pursuers in the same background geography."

invariants.rule: The terminal obstacle converts pursuit into a measurable unresolved distance without false resolution.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal obstacle converts pursuit into a measurable unresolved distance without false resolution."
